title: infra_pr_audit_fix_plan
description: Atomic fix-plan output document produced by the devspec_pr_audit skill (Part B). One document represents the ordered task list for a single review round and scope. Tasks must appear in topological order (all deps declared before the task that references them). Each task modifies exactly one file; multi-file changes must be split.

round.description: Review round ordinal, 1..max_rounds (5). Increments per review-fix iteration.

scope.description: Short identifier of the review scope this plan addresses. Must match the scope of the corresponding findings document for document pairing to work.

generated_at.description: Unix-epoch seconds (integer) when this document was emitted. Used for run correlation; not a uniqueness key.

tasks.description: Ordered array of atomic fix tasks. Tasks must appear in topological order — a task's deps must reference only tasks that appear earlier in this array.

task.description: One atomic fix task. Modifies exactly one file. Multi-file changes must be split into separate tasks. Tasks must appear in topological order with respect to their deps.

id.description: Task identifier (e.g., T1, T01, D1). The prefix letter is a naming convention only — use the kind field for the authoritative task category. Used as a dependency reference key. Note: the D prefix is unrelated to catalog_tag D-codes (D1-D14); a task with id 'D1' does NOT correspond to drift type D1.

kind.description: Task category. Used by the consolidator and human reviewers to classify tasks; the schema does not enforce sequencing or acceptance-command conventions per kind.

priority.description: Task priority for scheduling. P0 = blocker, P1 = high, P2 = medium, P3 = low/docs/cleanup. Governance constraint (not enforced by schema): a P3 task must only address findings of severity P2; using P3 to defer a P0 or P1 finding is a violation that the consolidator's verifier should reject.

deps.description: Other task IDs this task depends on. Must reference tasks declared earlier in the array (topological order). Forward references are forbidden — the consolidator must order tasks before writing this document. Omission is equivalent to an empty array; the schema does not coerce absent values.

file.description: Single file modified by this task. Multi-file changes must be split into separate tasks. Path is relative to git root.

change_summary.description: One-line description of the change. Concrete, not aspirational.

acceptance_command.description: Shell command (runnable verbatim) that returns non-zero if the change is incomplete or incorrect. e.g., pytest -k test_x, specdev spec-check ...

findings.description: List of finding signatures (from findings.schema.json) this task addresses. At least one finding per task.
